Rules summary Contents 1 Objective 2 Turn Overview 3 Victory Conditions 4 End Game Scoring 5 Location Rules 5.1 Cabaret 5.2 Finance Center 5.3 Racetrack 6 Action Options 7 Special Actions 7.1 Bonuses Objective Win by either: • Collecting 3 characters of the same suit, OR • Collecting 1 character from each of the 5 suits If no one achieves a victory condition, the player with the most Prestige points from characters and special actions wins. Turn Overview Players alternate turns. On your turn: • Place the Action token on a different action space (you can't repeat the last action). • Perform the listed actions in the specified order. • At the end of the turn, check if you've rallied any characters. If a victory condition is met, the game ends immediately. Victory Conditions Game ends immediately if: • You have 3 characters of the same suit • You have 1 character from each of the 5 suits Otherwise, the game ends immediately when the last character of any location is rallied. End Game Scoring Add up Prestige points on all your characters +1 for an unused Special Action tile on your board +1 per discarded Special Action tile during the game If tied, whoever has the most characters wins. If still tied, play again. Location Rules Cabaret Place Influence tokens to form a continuous orthogonal path from one edge to the other. You may also rally a character by occupying all 4 matching circle spaces. Tokens must always be placed orthogonally adjacent to another token (any color). Finance Center Advance your Ascension token upward. If you reach or pass a character, you rally it. If you're behind your opponent → move 2 spaces If tied/ahead → move 1 space Racetrack Place tokens from left to right on available tracks. When a track fills, the player with the majority takes the character. Return tokens; that track is now closed (overlay tile). Action Options Each main action specifies what to do and in what order: Place Influence in Cabaret (1 or 2 tokens) Advance in Finance and/or place in Racetrack Each turn must use a new action space Special Actions Unique, powerful one-time actions Placed on your player board, replacing any existing special Examples include: • Place 3 tokens at Cabaret • Swap Influence tokens with opponent • Advance in Finance and place in Racetrack • Draw multiple Special Action tiles and choose one Bonuses Some spaces grant bonuses when you land on or cover them Bonuses include: • Swap characters • Extra placement • Influence swap • Advance Ascension • Restrict opponent's next action.

[Rating: 3/10] A game that offers players the opportunity to create satisfying turns, but then takes agency away by having your opponent often dictate where you play. You are then required to proceed through those dictations to unsatisfying ends. Such weaponization of agency can be done well (see the Field of the Cloth of Gold). Here it just completely makes the game unpleasant in a truly disjointed way.
